meta.description: A Postman-specific response that contains information about the internal performed operation.

revision.description: An internal revision ID. Its value increments each time the resource changes. You can use this ID to track whether there were changes since the last time you fetched the resource.

owner.description: The user ID of the request's owner.

folder.description: Information about the request's parent folder.

responses.description: A list of the request's responses.

collection.description: The collection ID that the request belongs to.

responses_order.description: A list of response IDs and their order in the folder.

createdAt.description: The requeset's creation date and time.

updatedAt.description: The date and time at which the request was last updated.

lastUpdatedBy.description: The user ID of the user that last updated the folder.
